translations.web: and said, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you turn, and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.
translations.bsb: “Truly I tell you,” He said, “unless you change and become like little children, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.
translations.kjv: And said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.
